oral_examination.oral_examination: Facial shape, upper and lower lips protrude. The permanent dentition has a similar relationship between the bilateral canines and molars, and the overbite coverage of the anterior teeth is normal. Mild crowding of upper jaw.

treatment_plan.notes: Ask for follow-up consultation if you feel unwell. Bite a cotton roll for 40 minutes. Do not brush your teeth or rinse your mouth for 24 hours. You can eat and drink after 2 hours. It is recommended that the food should not be too hot.

source_handle: Take impressions, take pictures, and agree to discuss the plan next week
